fullContentHtml:
UKPSC Upper PCS Admit Card Notice 2026 – Full Details

Uttarakhand Public Service Commission (UKPSC) has released the Admit Card Notice for the post of Combined State Civil/ Upper Subordinate Services PCS Exam 2026. This recruitment was released for 67 posts. Applications for the UKPSC Upper PCS Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 09 September 2026, to 29 September 2026. The pre examination is going to conducted on 29 November 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their UKPSC Upper PCS Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 09 September 2026
  • Last Date : 29 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 29 September 2026
  • Correction Date : 07-16 October 2026
  • Exam Date : 29 November 2026
  • Admit Card : 13 November 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 166.36/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 76.36/-
  • PH : Rs. 16.36/-
  • Orphan (Anath) : Rs. 00/-

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Click on the official Admit Card link given below.
  2. Login using your Application Number / Roll Number and Password / DOB.
  3. Your Admit Card will be displayed on screen.
  4. Download the PDF and take a clear printout to carry to the exam venue.

Important Links

  • Apply Online
  • Download Notification
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is UKPSC Upper PCS Admit Card Notice 2026?

UKPSC Upper PCS Admit Card Notice 2026 is the official hall ticket for the upcoming examination. Candidates must carry it along with a valid photo ID to the exam centre.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
